context.body: The baptism in four witnesses · John 1:29–34
context.label: Canonical location

observations.body: John calls Jesus God’s Lamb, says Jesus ranks before him, and explains that the purpose of his water baptism was Israel’s recognition.
observations.label: John identifies Jesus by a descending and remaining Spirit: action

observations.body: John testifies that he saw the Spirit descend and remain, receiving that sign from the one who sent him.
observations.label: John identifies Jesus by a descending and remaining Spirit: response

observations.body: Lamb of God · did not know him · revealed to Israel · descend and remain · Son of God
observations.label: Words in John 1:29–34

payload.posture: Read John 1:29–34 as the baptism in four witnesses evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The testimony links water, revelation, Spirit, and recognition while leaving the physical act offstage.
payload.title: John identifies Jesus by a descending and remaining Spirit
